latency_ms.scope: in-process search only; excludes process startup and index construction

limitations: The 105-query set contains 35 Codex-authored intent clusters and has no human-reviewed labels.
Latency on an in-memory 14-document corpus does not predict production latency.
When filters are enabled, unsupported hard-filter keys are reported and left to lexical matching.
No statistical significance or generalization claim is made.
